data.name: Herve
data.gender_notes: Herve is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Germanic 'Heribert' or Latin 'Heribertus', Herve means 'strong, bright, famous'. This name was popular in the Middle Ages, particularly among the Frankish and Germanic peoples. It is derived from the Germanic elements 'heri' meaning 'army, warrior' and 'berht' meaning 'bright'. The name Herve carries the meaning “Strong, bright, famous” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Herve usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, bright, famous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name representing strength and brightness, symbolic of the light of faith in God.
data.etymology: Herve belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, bright, famous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Herve total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
